purpose: Define deterministic, auditable and replayable commands for the P0-A formula workbench.

fields.idempotency_key: Stable UUID reused only when retrying the same semantic command
fields.expected_revision: Client last-seen formula revision; required for optimistic concurrency
fields.actor_id: Authenticated user id or temporary guest id
fields.scene_id: Presentation scene; excluded from core formula hash
fields.issued_at: ISO-8601 client timestamp for diagnostics; server timestamp is authoritative

rules: A successful mutating command increments revision by exactly one.
An idempotent retry returns the original success response and does not increment revision.
Scene wording may vary, but component_delta and formula_hash must not depend on scene_id.

codes.FORMULA_NOT_FOUND: Formula id does not exist or actor has no access.
codes.REVISION_CONFLICT: expected_revision does not equal current revision.
codes.DUPLICATE_COMMAND_MISMATCH: Idempotency key was reused with different payload.
codes.INVALID_QUANTITY: Quantity is missing, non-finite, zero where positive is required, or outside command limits.
codes.BLOCK_NOT_FOUND: Scent block id is absent from the referenced library version.
codes.COMPONENT_NOT_FOUND: Target component does not exist in current formula.
codes.COMPONENT_ALREADY_EXISTS: Add was requested for an existing component; use increase or set quantity.
codes.LAST_COMPONENT_REMOVAL_BLOCKED: Removing the final active component requires explicit clear-formula command in a later protocol version.
codes.UNDO_BOUNDARY_REACHED: Undo cannot cross a sealed or explicitly committed snapshot boundary.
codes.ANALYSIS_IN_PROGRESS: A duplicate full analysis request is already running for the same formula revision.
codes.FORMULA_SEALED: Mutating command cannot edit a sealed version; branch it first.
codes.INVALID_STATE: Command is not allowed in the current workbench state.
codes.ENGINE_INPUT_INVALID: Formula cannot be analyzed; preserve current formula and return validation evidence.
codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: Unexpected failure; command must not partially mutate the aggregate.

quantity_policy.normalization: Only the scent engine converts quantities to normalized shares. Commands store relative quantities unchanged.

guards: formula retains at least one component
quantity resolves to positive finite value
commands.atomicity: Remove source and add target in one aggregate transaction and one revision.

commands.behavior: Append compensating event; never delete historical event.
Analyze an immutable snapshot of the requested formula revision.

guards: latest full analysis matches current revision

commands.behavior: Create a new editable formula aggregate from an immutable version snapshot.

guards: target scene supports current protocol version
commands.behavior: Change presentation mapping only; formula revision and formula hash remain unchanged.

guards: latest full analysis matches current revision

event_log_policy.redaction: Production-layer secrets and private supplier data must not be copied into public or client-visible event payloads.
event_log_policy.replay: Replaying all accepted mutating events from formula_created must rebuild the same canonical formula state and formula hash.

concurrency_policy.conflict_response: Return current revision, compact component delta since expected revision, and require explicit client rebase or retry.
concurrency_policy.reason: Silent merges can change perfume proportions without the player's awareness.
